description: The figure is a grouped vertical bar chart illustrating how a metric labeled “γ_B” varies across different “Number of Shots” settings, with bars separated by outcome category as indicated by the legend. The horizontal axis contains the categories “Number of Shots,” shown in increasing order with labeled ticks at 0, 1, 2, 3, and 4. The vertical axis is labeled “γ_B” and uses a linear numeric scale with visible tick labels at approximately 0.2, 0.4, and 0.6 (the plotted bars extend above 0.6, approaching roughly the 0.8 range). For each shot count, there are two adjacent bars: a blue bar with a dotted hatch pattern labeled “Incorrect” in the legend, and a magenta bar with diagonal hatch lines (the corresponding legend label is partially cropped but represents the second category). Approximate bar heights for the blue “Incorrect” series increase from about 0.45 at 0 shots to ~0.50 at 1 shot, ~0.56 at 2 shots, ~0.60 at 3 shots, and ~0.65 at 4 shots. The magenta hatched bars are consistently higher, at roughly ~0.75 (0 shots), ~0.77 (1 shot), ~0.80 (2 shots), ~0.85 (3 shots), and ~0.78 (4 shots). The bars are grouped side-by-side within each shot category (not stacked), with no visible error bars or numeric annotations, and there is no indication that bars are sorted by value beyond the natural ascending order of the shot-count categories.
